metadata.title: Texas Whataburger manager beat suspect with trash can after alleged assault, video shows

left: A Whataburger manager used a trash can to subdue a customer who allegedly assaulted workers.
The customer, identified as Anthony William Newhuis, was arrested for assault and public intoxication.
After being taken to jail, Newhuis intentionally flooded the cells and was charged with criminal mischief.
